summary: Added an opt-in framework StepReuseController and model-adapter contract beside the shared diffusion denoising loop. It owns request/scope-local prediction history, bounded reuse, post-CFG observations, trace-only decisions, replica-control-rank decision broadcast, forced terminal forwards, terminal side-effect verification, scheduler-step preservation, and per-scope metrics. Reuse remains disabled by default.

tests.what_was_measured: Failing-before reproduction: the recorded base has no framework step-reuse controller or contract. Raw evidence: reports/j-d12b97de72cb/before-reproduction.log

16 tests covering real-history warmup, bounded countdown, no recursive observations, scheduler advancement during reuse, terminal writes, request/modality/CFG-role/retry isolation, malformed configuration and budgets, control-rank tokens, trace-only mode, and compatibility with CFG gating. Raw output: reports/j-d12b97de72cb/unit-tests.log
68 compatibility tests plus 30 subtests for unchanged request configuration and denoising graph behavior. Raw output: reports/j-d12b97de72cb/compatibility-tests.log
Repository formatting, lint, AST, secret, and policy hooks. Raw output: reports/j-d12b97de72cb/pre-commit.log

On one AMD Instinct MI350X, a six-step FP32 recurrence with trace real,real,reuse,reuse,real,terminal-real agreed with an independent CPU float64 recurrence (maximum absolute difference 3.784894948566375e-07, rtol=1e-5, atol=1e-6). Raw output: reports/j-d12b97de72cb/gpu-numerical.log

gpu_execution.evidence: One assigned AMD Instinct MI350X was used with torch 2.11.0+rocm7.2 / HIP 7.2.26015; reports/j-d12b97de72cb/gpu-numerical.log records device discovery and the independent CPU-reference comparison.

remaining_limitations: No model adapter is enabled: the issue requires architecture-specific observation points, similarity/quality thresholds, and side-effect metadata, and none can be honestly selected without a qualified model and evaluation data.

No cache-off versus cache-on public output quality metric or full internal model trajectory was run because model weights and a qualified diffusion fixture were unavailable; the tiny Llama serving fixture is not applicable to diffusion semantics.
Persistent session/KV equality was tested only through the synthetic terminal verification contract, not against a stateful world-model implementation.
Replica decision synchronization is unit-tested with independent control/follower controllers, but no multi-GPU distributed job was run because the task permits one assigned GPU.
The integration applies to the shared DenoisingStage path. Model-specific stages that override _run_denoising_step must explicitly adopt the same controller hooks before opting in.
No native rebuild was applicable because all changed implementation and tests are Python; the prepared environment records native=null.
